exceptions.reason: No rated hard source or validated harder structure. Package is bounded to observed cancelling terms/constants and isolating a linear parameter. Extra arithmetic alone does not establish hard difficulty. New evidence reopens classification.
Unrated incomplete sources lack correct designation/solution; blank lacks bank. Preserve unchanged and exclude from fidelity/inventory.

distinctness_policy: One reduced parameter ratio per method. Renamed variables, changed unequal constants, common coefficient scale, seeds, identities and choice order are not distinct tasks. Easy source-profile mathematical banks must have five unique values.
